root_cause.text: The `struct ionic_cq_resp` is allocated on the kernel stack without being initialized, and not all of its fields (specifically `rsvd[7]` and potentially `cqid[1]`) are explicitly set before the structure is copied to userspace, leading to a kernel stack memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the declaration from `struct ionic_cq_resp resp;` to `struct ionic_cq_resp resp = {};`, which zero-initializes the entire structure. The CVE description confirms that `rsvd[7]` is never set and `cqid[1]` may not be written in all cases, exposing uninitialized stack bytes.
